title: Therapeutic Closing Charge: Extended-Hold Rate Percentages
content:
**Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations — the extended-hold percentages on the therapeutic closing charge.**

*What is counted?* The leave's privately held days already charged, counted as the days recorded on the bed-hold charges posted on the reservation, together with the therapeutic closing entry's days (its days as booked, net of any reversed against it).

*What percentage of the schedule rate applies?*

- more than 30 days: 85 percent (long-hold);
- at least 15 and no more than 30 days: 95 percent (mid-hold);
- fewer than 15 days: 100 percent (full rate).

*Is the entry being priced counted?* Yes, its days are added to the days on charges already posted on the reservation.

*Hypothetical counts.* 9 charged plus an entry of 5 is 14: 100 percent. 9 plus 6 is 15: 95 percent. 18 plus 12 is 30: 95 percent. 18 plus 13 is 31: 85 percent.
